name: Arm Circle
body: stands tall with her feet hip-width apart and both arms extended straight out to her sides at shoulder height, caught mid-way through a small circle with her palms facing down and her shoulders relaxed away from her ears. Shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Arm Circle with Small Weight
body: stands with her feet hip-width apart holding a small dumbbell in each hand, both arms extended straight out to her sides at shoulder height with palms facing down, mid-way through a small circle. Shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Arm Scissor
body: stands with her feet hip-width apart and both arms extended straight in front of her at shoulder height, one arm crossed just above the other mid-scissor, palms facing down. Shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Double Leg Stretch
body: lies on her back with her head and shoulders curled up off the floor, both knees drawn in toward her chest and both arms reaching around them, body rounded into a tight ball shape. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Frog Heel Squeeze
body: lies on her back with her knees bent and dropped wide open to the sides, the soles of her feet together and her heels pressed toward each other, hips resting heavy on the floor and arms long at her sides. Inner thighs softly washed in sage green.

name: Depth Jump
body: has just stepped off a sturdy wooden plyo box and is dropping toward the floor with her body tall and both feet about to land together, knees softly bent and arms swinging back. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Depth Jump to Broad Jump
body: is caught in mid-air mid-way through a broad jump with both feet together and knees bent, arms swept back behind her, having just left a sturdy wooden plyo box behind her. Glutes and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Decline Push Up
body: holds a push-up with both hands planted on the floor and both feet raised on a low stable bench behind her, body in one straight line from head to heels, arms extended. Chest and shoulders softly washed in dusty rose.

name: High Knees Sprint
body: sprints on the spot driving one knee up to hip height with the opposite foot pushing off the floor, torso tall and arms bent and pumping hard in opposition. Hip flexors and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Cross Body Mountain Climbers
body: holds a high plank on both hands with one knee drawn across her body toward the opposite elbow, the other leg extended long behind her, hips level and back flat. Obliques softly washed in sage green.

name: Reverse Crunch
body: lies on her back with her arms long at her sides and palms pressed to the floor, drawing her knees in over her hips and curling her tailbone up off the floor so her lower back lifts. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Reformer Long Box T-Pull
body: lies on her stomach along a long padded box on the reformer, arms reaching forward and gripping the straps with both hands, sweeping them out to the sides and back past her shoulders in a wide T, chest lifted and legs long behind her.

name: Reformer Long Stretch
body: holds a long plank on the reformer with both hands pressing on the footbar and both feet on the carriage, carriage pushed back so her body forms one long straight line from head to heels.
